title: Projects
subtitle: Research, platform, tooling, and product-facing code.

npu-computing-forecast.title: Compute Forecasting for Hybrid Training and Inference Deployment
npu-computing-forecast.summary: A Huawei collaboration project that predicts Ascend NPU resource usage for recommendation-model and large-model training/inference, supporting co-location and higher utilization.

projectIntro: Uses XGBoost to estimate NPU AI Core, Vector Core, HBM, and other resource usage from recommendation-model workload features.
Uses LightGBM to predict large-model inference performance, including TTFT, TPOT, KV Cache, and the hardware resource usage above.
Explores GNNs for ONNX/PyTorch recommendation-model structures, aiming to generalize to unseen models.
Continuing to push forward work related to large models...
personalWork: Led a data collection framework covering TorchRec, DeepCTR, Torch-RecHub, RecSDK, and other recommendation stacks.
Implemented configuration parsing, validation, and version management for safe large-scale experiments.
Implemented multiple NPU-side monitoring tools based on npu-smi, npu-exporter, DCMI programming interfaces, and related components.
Implemented CPU-side monitoring with vmstat, sar, cgroup, and lxcfs, using cross-validation for accurate container data.
Built hands-on understanding of Ascend NPU architecture, workload behavior, and hardware debugging.

crater.title: Crater Cloud-Native AI Platform
crater.summary: RAIDS Lab's Kubernetes AI training and inference platform for teams sharing GPU clusters. It integrates resource requests, dev environments, training jobs, inference services, monitoring, and related workflows.

projectIntro: Our deployment manages 280+ accelerators and 5,600+ CPU cores, with 200+ jobs created per day for 600+ users.
Replaces the lab's previous Slurm tooling with a polished GUI for teachers and students.
Also serves as a systems research platform for scheduling algorithms, distributed storage, and related experiments.
Implemented Crater's own admission controller, working with Kubernetes, the Volcano scheduler, and self-developed algorithms to schedule user workloads fairly and efficiently.
Supports snapshots and multiple image-building workflows with Buildx, Envd, and related tools.
Supports NFS, Ceph, and large user/shared datasets for reuse across images.
Provides model and dataset download/management to reduce waiting time and storage pressure.
Mostly completed an embedded Q&A agent to help users query and locate problems faster.
personalWork: As a **core project maintainer**, actively shaped product direction, requirements analysis and specifications, implementation reviews, and led project interns through hands-on delivery.
Developed new features with AI, reported and fixed bugs, improved UX, and reviewed PRs to deliver a better experience for platform users.
Built a complete set of development Skills for the project, capturing constraints and experience to help AI developers write code, author documentation, and manage releases more effectively.
Faced real **user needs** directly and built practical engineering problem-solving experience.

crater-cli.title: Crater CLI
crater-cli.summary: A Go CLI subproject for operating Crater through AI agents, scripts, and related workflows.

projectIntro: Provides a new way to access and operate the Crater platform for script/CLI users and AI agents in the new era.
Gradually connecting the APIs of Crater modules...
personalWork: Provides architecture, spec, command, and review docs, using documentation-driven development for AI-era coding.
Provides multilingual Tab completion and survey-style interactive selection across shells.
Distributes Skills, supports non-interactive/formatted output, and defines error codes for agent use and troubleshooting.
Implements sandboxed network and storage access so tests do not affect real environments or cluster data.

Improves AI-generated code reliability with unit tests and a sandbox-based snapshot/golden-file mechanism that leaves reference examples for later AI coding and lets reviewers see real command output.
Designed from scratch, accumulating architecture design experience and real engineering reflections.

model-requirements-evaluator.title: Equivalent Modeling and Evaluation of Model Compute Requirements
model-requirements-evaluator.summary: Models inference-time resource requirements for LLMs across vendors' hardware. Given a model, GPU, concurrency, and latency needs, it produces deployment plans that satisfy the constraints.

projectIntro: Won third prize in the 2nd 'China Data Valley Huawei Cup' China Graduate Operating System Open Source Innovation Competition.
Decomposes large language model structure and uses mathematical methods to model the storage and compute requirements of each part of the model.
personalWork: Built a modern frontend with Vue 3, TypeScript, Vite, and Element Plus, packaging backend capabilities into an interactive product.
Integrated ECharts and ECharts-GL to visualize latency, throughput, memory, and phase progress, showing how requirement changes affect deployment cost.

personal-homepage.title: Personal Homepage and Content System
personal-homepage.summary: This site is also a long-running frontend project for HR, interviewers, open-source peers, and students. It organizes job-search presentation, open-source activity, and related content into a maintainable static site.

projectIntro: Lets HR and interviewers understand my projects, direction, toolchain, and working style without searching across scattered repositories.
Supports multilingual content, responsive layout, and light/dark modes, while controlling maximum image brightness in dark mode to avoid glare.
